title: Evidence-coverage matrix
question: What is actually known, disputed, or missing?
limitations: Field presence is not source completeness; unknown is not failure.

title: Sector–disposition heatmap
question: How do selected dispositions differ by challenged operator?
limitations: Selected composition is not a population probability; sector is analytical coding.

title: Outcome-stage matrix
question: What kind of favorable or adverse result is documented?
limitations: One summary compresses event history; an order is not proof of restoration.

title: Habeas route map
question: Which legal review mechanism applied?
limitations: Similar harms may involve different legal routes; missing vehicle is not evidence of no habeas proceeding.

title: Technology–sector chart
question: Which technologies occur in which selected sectors?
limitations: Broad technology categories overlap in reality; ownership does not decide state action.

title: Topic heatmap
question: Which challenged mechanisms are repeatedly annotated?
limitations: Tags denote selected challenged topics, not judicially established defects; untagged does not prove absence.

title: Topic overlap and case-neighbor explorer
question: Which topics co-occur, and which selected families share annotations?
unit: topic pair or selected litigation-family pair
limitations: Annotation overlap is similarity, not a causal relationship; tagging choices determine the distance.

title: Source-linked timeline
question: When were the selected legal anchors decided?
limitations: Historical coverage is not filing incidence or litigation duration.

title: Coding-sensitivity plot
question: Does alternative sector coding change descriptive association?
limitations: Scenarios are not confidence intervals; retain the same underlying families for each comparison.

title: Restoration-evidence chart
question: Is actual correction reported in the reviewed sources?
limitations: Any-stage release or repayment may precede the selected judgment; missing follow-up is not failed remedy.

title: Causal assumption diagram
question: What selection, confounding, and mediating relationships need measurement?
limitations: Arrows are design assumptions, not empirically fitted causal effects.

title: Legal-barrier map
question: Where do jurisdiction, standing, immunity, procedure, or merits block particular claims?
limitations: Needs claim-level holdings and source passages; analyst interpretation must remain separate.

title: Event-state swimlanes
question: How did orders, appeals, stays, and completed remedies change over time?
limitations: Requires dated event coding; a later reversal must not overwrite the earlier event.

title: Review funnel
question: Where do eligible matters leave or branch through the review process?
limitations: Requires unselected denominators and competing or branching paths; filed cases do not represent all harmed people.

title: Cumulative-incidence curves
question: How long until correction with competing outcomes considered?
limitations: Requires competing-event definitions and censoring assumptions; missing outcome is not a non-event.

title: Court-year small multiples
question: Do comparable outcomes differ across contexts?
limitations: Requires compatible definitions and case mix; avoid naive court rankings.

title: Citation network
question: How are public legal authorities connected in the corpus?
limitations: Citation is neither endorsement nor proven causal influence.

title: Reviewer-agreement matrix
question: Can independent reviewers reproduce classifications?
limitations: Agreement is not truth; report prevalence, overlap selection, and missingness.

title: Cluster-stability plots
question: Do exploratory groupings persist under recoding and independent validation?
limitations: Outcomes must not leak into predictor features; similarity alone does not establish a natural class or common cause.

title: Capacity–delay curve
question: At what measured load do delay and error rates change?
limitations: Operational measurements are absent; task complexity and selection can confound load associations.

title: Latency decomposition
question: Which handoff consumes the time before effective correction?
limitations: Timestamp definitions and clock synchronization must be comparable; acknowledgment differs from correction.

title: Error confusion matrix
question: Which independently established errors are detected or missed?
limitations: Reference labels have uncertainty; requires a defined error opportunity denominator.

title: Control charts
question: Does recurrence depart from a stable operational baseline?
limitations: Requires stable definitions and enough repeated periods; autocorrelation and case-mix changes affect limits.

title: Intervention-effect forest plot
question: Which tested interventions improve outcomes and with what uncertainty?
limitations: No intervention estimates yet; account for multiplicity, overlapping samples, clustering, and transportability.

title: Correction-propagation network
question: Did each operative endpoint apply and verify the correction?
limitations: Receiving a message does not establish that an operative record or action changed.
